name: Audio meter
author: jake
description: Live microphone and speaker levels as a split meter: mic in on one side, sound out on the other, with volume and mute on each.

barWidget.description: Mic in and sound out as a split level meter. Scroll a side to change its volume, click it to mute.

schema.label: Bars
schema.description: Vertical: two columns side by side, mic on the left. Horizontal: two rows, mic on top. Line: one bar split in the middle, sound out filling left and mic in filling right.

schema.label: Style
schema.description: Segments like an LED meter, or one solid fill.

schema.label: Bar height (vertical)
schema.description: How tall the vertical bars are, in pixels.
